DECLARE

 v_string varchar2(300);
 chp_sysdate date;
 v_chp_sysdate VARCHAR2(20);
 v_temp_sysdate VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
 -- Added on 05/06/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 v_chp_sysdate := TO_CHAR(chp_sysdate, 'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'); 
 ---------- 
 v_temp:='HOLDS';
 go_block('donor_interdictions');
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_donor='A' then /* All holds for this donor */
 
 v_string:='donor_id=:donations.donor_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';

 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_donor='D' then /* Active donation holds */
 
 v_temp_sysdate := 'to_date(''' || v_chp_sysdate || ''',''MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'')';
 
 --v_string:='donor_id=:donations.donor_id and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) and transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';

 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_donor='H' then /* All donation holds */

 v_string:='donor_id=:donations.donor_id and transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';
 
 end if;

 set_block_property('donor_interdictions',default_where,v_string); 
 :system.message_level:=10;

 :system.message_level:=0;

END;

PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_o (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

FUNCTION tot_no_of_records RETURN NUMBER IS
 v_count number:=0;
BEGIN
 go_block('donations');
 first_record;

 Loop

 if :donations.unit_id is not null then
 v_count:=v_count+1;
 end if;

 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;

 End loop;

 return v_count;
 
END;
